[1/4] Plan the screenshot-led games section: public games reuse dossier captures via project.html links; private games render as unlinked teaser articles with local shots

impact_assessment.why: The site mirrors only public repos, so private and in-development games are invisible; a games gallery makes the page show every game regardless of repo visibility
impact_assessment.benefits: Showcase surface for unreleased work; reuses digest-verified dossier captures for public games, so zero new manifests; no change to PUBLIC_REPOS assertions
impact_assessment.risks: contract: cards regex (class=project reveal + data-repo-url) must not match private entries or test_site_lists_every_public_repository_once breaks; contract: dossier manifests are builder-owned, must not be hand-edited; dependency: screenshot files must exist locally under docs/ (self-containment test); concurrency: none (single-writer session, dossier lock untouched); state: index.html is a tracked UI surface, ui begin/verify/finish required
impact_assessment.mitigation: Private entries as non-anchor articles with a distinct class outside the regex; reference dossier capture paths read-only; add a failing-first test pinning that private game entries never carry data-repo-url; run ui ceremony and full check --strict before any commit

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: M1 failing tests pin ingest/register/check/sync contract; M2 implement tools/build_game_teasers.py; M3 wire markers in index.html, replace hand-written placeholder, README tree, gates, delivery

impact_assessment.why: Private-game teasers are managed by hand: files dropped into docs/assets/games and markup edited directly, with no manifest, no optimization and no consistency check.
impact_assessment.benefits: Teaser publishing becomes one command per screenshot plus sync, with the same optimization, verification and atomicity the dossier media pipeline already has.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: sync owning markup could clobber hand edits - mitigated by a fully-owned block between explicit markers and a placeholder render when the manifest is empty; dependency: new tool imports build_dossier_media primitives - mitigated by importing stable functions only, no network reuse; concurrency: two syncs could interleave - mitigated by atomic file replaces and manifesto single-writer CLI use; state: teasers.json corruption - mitigated by temp-plus-replace writes with a .bak shadow.
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first tests before implementation; bounded marker-scoped replace in sync, idempotent on re-run; README tree updated in the same commit.
